rules.name: stake_backed
rules.why: staked total backed by staking tokens held

rules.name: stake_sync
rules.expr: ok and (called("stake") or called("withdraw") or called("exit") or called("getReward")) and post("totalSupply") + pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) != pre("totalSupply") + post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: totalSupply and staking-token holdings move together

rules.name: rewards_backed
rules.why: owed rewards backed by reward tokens

rules.name: paid_index_monotone
rules.expr: ok and post("userRewardPerTokenPaid", u) < pre("userRewardPerTokenPaid", u)

rules.name: accrual_custom
rules.expr: ok and post("periodFinish") >= post("rewardsDuration") and wide(post_sum("rewards")) > wide(post("rewardRate")) * (now - (post("periodFinish") - post("rewardsDuration")))
rules.why: stored rewards never exceed rate times time elapsed

rules.name: stake_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("stake") and (post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + arg(0) or post("balanceOf", sender) != pre("balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) or post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) or post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender))

rules.name: withdraw_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and (post("totalSupply") + arg(0) != pre("totalSupply") or post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender) + arg(0))

rules.name: exit_clears
rules.expr: ok and called("exit") and (post("balanceOf", sender) != 0 or post("rewards", sender) != 0)

rules.name: exit_returns_stake
rules.expr: ok and called("exit") and post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender) != pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender) + pre("balanceOf", sender)

rules.name: getreward_clears
rules.expr: ok and called("getReward") and post("rewards", sender) != 0

rules.name: getreward_pays_owed
rules.expr: ok and (called("getReward") or called("exit")) and post("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", sender) < pre("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", sender) + pre("rewards", sender)
rules.why: claim pays at least stored rewards

rules.name: getreward_no_stake_change
rules.expr: ok and called("getReward") and (post("balanceOf", u) != pre("balanceOf", u) or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply"))

rules.name: stake_withdraw_keep_rewards
rules.expr: ok and (called("stake") or called("withdraw")) and post("rewards", sender) < pre("rewards", sender)

rules.name: stake_withdraw_no_rwd_move
rules.expr: ok and (called("stake") or called("withdraw")) and post("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: stake_third_party
rules.why: nobody loses stake in others' calls

rules.name: rewards_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("rewards", u) < pre("rewards", u)

rules.name: stk_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("stake") or called("withdraw") or called("exit") or called("getReward")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: staking calls never take others' tokens

rules.name: rwd_out_only_to_claimer
rules.expr: ok and (called("stake") or called("withdraw") or called("exit") or called("getReward")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", u) != pre("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: rewards only paid to the caller

params.forbidden: sender != pre("owner") or arg(0) == A1 or arg(0) == A2

rules.name: recover_no_core_tokens
rules.expr: ok and called("recoverERC20") and (post("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", A0) or post("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC02_RWD.balanceOf", A0))
rules.why: recover never moves staking or reward tokens

params.condition: arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= pre("TokenC02_STK.balanceOf", sender) and arg(0) <= pre("TokenC02_STK.allowance", sender, A0) and pre("entered") == 0
